title: The coolest use for the Vision Pro
excerpt: One day there will hopefully be a house on this land Over the last year, I admittedly haven’t used my Vision Pro a ton, but fairly recently I discovered a super handy use that it’s absolutely incredible at, provided you have the right tools. After years of apartment life my girlfriend and I have recently begun the process of building our (first! exciting!) home, which is an absolute whirlwind of choices and decisions. Maybe it’s where we’re both programmers, but particularly for me, my software-oriented brain feels almost incompatible with this world of designing a home (she’s the main one keeping this project moving forward).
content_html:
July 29, 2026

Over the last year, I admittedly haven’t used my Vision Pro a ton, but fairly recently I discovered a super handy use that it’s absolutely incredible at, provided you have the right tools.

After years of apartment life my girlfriend and I have recently begun the process of building our (first! exciting!) home, which is an absolute whirlwind of choices and decisions. Maybe it’s where we’re both programmers, but particularly for me, my software-oriented brain feels almost incompatible with this world of designing a home (she’s the main one keeping this project moving forward).

In software if you don’t end up liking a feature after playing around with it for awhile, you can tweak it or remove it entirely (try doing that with a poorly placed wall). Here, decisions feel huge and hard to commit to.

On top of this, the housing market is really expensive right now in many parts of the world (ours definitely included) so making good use of every square foot feels paramount.

(Don’t worry, we have a great architect who guides us skillfully, but ultimately it’s up to us to sign off on everything!)

Enter the Vision Pro

Looking at PDFs of potential floor plans, you don’t (or at least I don’t) develop much of a sense of scale or connections with a bunch of black rectangles. This room says it’s 13 feet by 15 feet, I guess I can get out a measuring tape, but what does that feel like? Would this hallway be cramped? What all can you see when you first walk into the house?

Then it hit me: virtual reality! There’s other VR devices that have better gaming chops, but I’m not sure there’s a consumer device out there that’s better than the Vision Pro on paper when it comes to rendering a virtual world with its high resolution screens and then placing you in it with its abundance of sensors.

Problem is, how do you go from floor plan to virtual reality?

Let’s get creatin’

I have a bit of experience using Fusion 360 (free 3D modeling software for hobbyists), so I had the idea to try to quickly build the floor plan up in 3D. Nothing fancy, just floors, ceilings, and walls, with holes for doors.

If you’re not familiar with 3D design tools, this is a great first project, you’re basically just drawing the floor plan out in 2D and then extruding out the walls. YouTube and asking AI questions are awesome resources for learning this handy skill in 2026. Sites like Fiverr are also a great resource, I’m sure there’s an abundance of people there who could take a floor plan you’re interested in and turn it into a 3D file for a reasonable price.

Leveling it up

A bunch of walls, ceilings, and holes in the wall is pretty powerful, but without actual objects or texture in the space it’s still a bit hard to get scale when you’re “walking around”.

You know how you walk into an empty apartment for the first time and you’re like “Holy crap there’s so much room” and then you add your belongings and there suddenly isn’t? It’s kinda like that, we need to add some models and materials to the space to actually ground our perspective a bit and give things scale, otherwise it feels like walking around a warehouse.

Adding textures

Quick easy one. In Fusion, tap the “A” key to bring up the Appearance panel and you can drag and drop a bunch of common textures like wood, stone, or paint onto objects. This can really help to break up the monotony of everything being the same dull texture and actually gives the place depth.

There’s even glass textures for windows which is pretty handy.

IKEA

I can model a counter or a kitchen island (just a bunch of rectangles) but anything beyond that and I’m tapping out. Thankfully IKEA has a massive amount of furniture with corresponding 3D models, and even if you’re not a big IKEA person (wow aren’t you fancy) having any approximation for your final furniture in your place really helps you get an idea of how things fit together and can be positioned.

Problem is, no easy way to get access to those 3D models from what I can tell. Thankfully, with a script for the Tampermonkey browser extension you can easily download them. Not every item on IKEA has a 3D model unfortunately, but seemingly the majority do.

This is super handy for adding a couch, a bed, a desk, an area rug, etc. to the space so when you walk into a bedroom your eyes kinda see the bed and desk and get a good idea for the scale of the room, which lets you understand if it’s a good size or if the dimensions are proper, and you can kinda imagine what it would be like to exist in that space.

Downside is this downloads a glb file, something I wasn’t familiar with. Fusion allows us to easily import obj files, so we need to convert it to that. After trying a bunch of scripts and websites, I honestly found this website to be the best. Little janky, but it works.

Also note that the resulting obj file (and the folder it’s contained in) often won’t render textures inside Fusion 360, but when you export them from Fusion they show up as expected.

3D Warehouse

That covers a lot of furniture, but not everything. Maybe you want to see how a stand mixer looks on the counter or if you can fit a rice cooker comfortably. Heck, you can find your car and put it in the garage for reference.

This is where 3D Warehouse comes in, it’s a community-driven website where people can upload free 3D models they create and easily import them into Sketchup, another popular piece of 3D modeling software (that might even work better than Fusion for house design, I dunno, haven’t used it much).

Problem is, the files aren’t easily usable in Fusion, but I found a nice workaround.

If you open the URL on your iOS device instead, it gives you the option to view it in 3D inside your current environment. Within that view, if you tap the share button you get access to the actual USDZ file that powers this experience, at which point you can just AirDrop it to your Mac. Nice!

From there, even though we love a USDZ file, Fusion seemingly doesn’t for importing objects, so back to that previous website to convert to OBJ. From there it’s as simple as bringing it into Fusion and placing it.

This website is seriously awesome, there’s a model for just about anything you’d put in your house.

Programming!

Now that I have something I’m happy with, I remembered Apple platforms love the USDZ file format for 3D models, and sure enough Fusion had a USDZ export option. Nice!

With a file in hand, we’re getting somewhere, so I AirDropped to it to my Vision Pro and opened it. This worked pretty okay for viewing it, and you could even walk around a little bit, but unless you live in a warehouse walking the full length of a virtual house without bumping into something and ending up in those VR fail compilations is pretty tricky. I want something better.

This is where vibe coding is perfect: putting something technically impressive together when you would have never bothered to take weeks to put it together traditionally. Is the code perfect? Nah, but the alternative is it never existing, and it’s just “for fun” anyway.

After some intense typing with a combination of Claude and Codex over the course of a morning I had something I was pretty happy with. I named it Prospector (can’t remember why) and I’ve been really happy with it.

Here are a bunch of the features that level it up beyond just viewing a USDZ file in the Files app:

  • Controller support! Walk around like you’re in a 3D video game, with motion controls as well as the ability to rotate the camera (you can still walk and look around normally of course, this just augments that).
  • Skybox! Pretty rudimentary, but added a forest style skybox as the exterior of the world so if you look out a window you don’t just see your current environment
  • Terrain following! If you tap the right D-pad button the controller will map you to the terrain, so you’ll go up and down with any undulations in the terrain. This is really handy if you have a survey of your property done so can effectively have a full view of your property’s terrain and “walk” through it
  • Toggle real life! If you hold your thumb and middle finger together for a moment it will toggle the virtual world on and off, this makes it feel safer if you want to take a step forward in virtual reality but are unsure if you’re going to bump into a table in real life.
  • Take flight! With the triggers you can fly up or down, great for going between floors for instance, and then if you press up on the D-pad it’ll reset you to the ground level.
  • Speed mode! Pressing left on the D-pad makes you move 6× faster, which is really, well, fast when you’re crossing a big property rather than poking around a single room.

With all those together, this is a really helpful way to view USDZ files on the Vision Pro. You can really easily explore a space and position yourself in new areas to look around, and even take off the headset to show a spouse or friend so you can gather their input on any changes. Then making a change is as simple as tweaking the file in Fusion, re-exporting, then re-running.

Download link

If you want to play around with Prospector, my super janky, vibe coded USDZ viewer, I put the contents up on GitHub (it would take a fair bit more work to polish this up into something I’d be comfortable submitting to the App Store).

Using it is as advertised: janky. Take your USDZ file, import it into Xcode, and inside ImmersiveView.swift change the USDZ file name to whatever the name of your file is. You can also tweak the skybox (Poly Haven has a bunch of awesome options). Then, just pair a controller to your Vision Pro and run the project on your device.

Just know I coded like 0% of this, so if it’s terrible you can’t judge me. Don’t you dare. I’m sensitive. Judge the AI.

This is awesome

No seriously, this feels so powerful. When we finally decided on a plan, through the fancy Revit software our architect uses he was able to bring us on a 3D walkthrough of our future house. It was cool, kinda like a Google Streetview-esque experience where you could click to teleport around the house and drag to look around.

But honestly, after already seeing it in full, immersive 3D where you can look around and feel like you’re there, we already felt like we knew the place. It really feels like one day in the future visiting potential designs in 3D will be a core part of the process, and if you have the hardware that future is possible today.

It’s kinda like that, we need to add some models and materials to the space to actually ground our perspective a bit and give things scale, otherwise it feels like walking around a warehouse.

sentences.en: You know how you walk into an empty apartment for the first time and you’re like “Holy crap there’s so much room” and then you add your belongings and there suddenly isn’t?
sentences.zh: 你知道当你第一次走进一间空荡荡的公寓时，你会想“天哪，这里有这么多空间”，然后你添加了你的物品，但突然就没有了？

sentences.en: It’s kinda like that, we need to add some models and materials to the space to actually ground our perspective a bit and give things scale, otherwise it feels like walking around a warehouse.
sentences.zh: 有点像这样，我们需要在空间中添加一些模型和材料，以实际地扎根我们的视角并赋予事物规模，否则感觉就像在仓库里走来走去。

blocks.html_en: Adding textures

sentences.en: Adding textures
sentences.zh: 添加纹理

blocks.html_en: Quick easy one. In Fusion, tap the “A” key to bring up the Appearance panel and you can drag and drop a bunch of common textures like wood, stone, or paint onto objects. This can really help to break up the monotony of everything being the same dull texture and actually gives the place depth.

sentences.en: Quick easy one.
sentences.zh: 快速简单的一个。

sentences.en: In Fusion, tap the “A” key to bring up the Appearance panel and you can drag and drop a bunch of common textures like wood, stone, or paint onto objects.
sentences.zh: 在 Fusion 中，点击“A”键打开“外观”面板，您可以将一堆常见纹理（例如木材、石头或油漆）拖放到对象上。

sentences.en: This can really help to break up the monotony of everything being the same dull texture and actually gives the place depth.
sentences.zh: 这确实有助于打破所有事物都具有相同的沉闷纹理的单调性，并且实际上赋予了地方深度。

blocks.html_en: There’s even glass textures for windows which is pretty handy.

sentences.en: There’s even glass textures for windows which is pretty handy.
sentences.zh: 窗户甚至还有玻璃纹理，非常方便。

blocks.html_en: IKEA

I can model a counter or a kitchen island (just a bunch of rectangles) but anything beyond that and I’m tapping out. Thankfully IKEA has a massive amount of furniture with corresponding 3D models, and even if you’re not a big IKEA person (wow aren’t you fancy) having any approximation for your final furniture in your place really helps you get an idea of how things fit together and can be positioned.

sentences.en: I can model a counter or a kitchen island (just a bunch of rectangles) but anything beyond that and I’m tapping out.
sentences.zh: 我可以模拟一个柜台或一个厨房岛（只是一堆矩形），但除此之外的任何东西我都会敲出。

sentences.en: Thankfully IKEA has a massive amount of furniture with corresponding 3D models, and even if you’re not a big IKEA person (wow aren’t you fancy) having any approximation for your final furniture in your place really helps you get an idea of how things fit together and can be positioned.
sentences.zh: 值得庆幸的是，宜家拥有大量带有相应 3D 模型的家具，即使您不是宜家的大佬（哇，您不喜欢吗），拥有您所在位置的最终家具的近似值确实可以帮助您了解事物如何组合在一起并如何定位。

blocks.html_en: <figcaption>The couch I'm typing this on. It's comfier in real life I promise.</figcaption>

sentences.en: The couch I'm typing this on.
sentences.zh: 我正在沙发上打字。

sentences.en: It's comfier in real life I promise.
sentences.zh: 我保证在现实生活中会更舒服。

blocks.html_en: Problem is, no easy way to get access to those 3D models from what I can tell. Thankfully, with a script for the Tampermonkey browser extension you can easily download them. Not every item on IKEA has a 3D model unfortunately, but seemingly the majority do.

sentences.en: Problem is, no easy way to get access to those 3D models from what I can tell.
sentences.zh: 问题是，据我所知，没有简单的方法可以访问这些 3D 模型。

sentences.en: Thankfully, with a script for the Tampermonkey browser extension you can easily download them.
sentences.zh: 值得庆幸的是，通过 Tampermonkey 浏览器扩展程序的脚本，您可以轻松下载它们。

sentences.en: Not every item on IKEA has a 3D model unfortunately, but seemingly the majority do.
sentences.zh: 遗憾的是，并非宜家的每件商品都有 3D 模型，但似乎大多数商品都有。

blocks.html_en: This is super handy for adding a couch, a bed, a desk, an area rug, etc. to the space so when you walk into a bedroom your eyes kinda see the bed and desk and get a good idea for the scale of the room, which lets you understand if it’s a good size or if the dimensions are proper, and you can kinda imagine what it would be like to exist in that space.

sentences.en: This is super handy for adding a couch, a bed, a desk, an area rug, etc. to the space so when you walk into a bedroom your eyes kinda see the bed and desk and get a good idea for the scale of the room, which lets you understand if it’s a good size or if the dimensions are proper, and you can kinda imagine what it would be like to exist in that space.
sentences.zh: 这对于在空间中添加沙发、床、桌子、地毯等非常方便，因此当您走进卧室时，您的眼睛会看到床和桌子，并对房间的规模有一个很好的了解，这可以让您了解房间的大小是否合适或尺寸是否合适，并且您可以想象存在于该空间中会是什么样子。

blocks.html_en: Downside is this downloads a glb file, something I wasn’t familiar with. Fusion allows us to easily import obj files, so we need to convert it to that. After trying a bunch of scripts and websites, I honestly found this website to be the best. Little janky, but it works.

sentences.en: Downside is this downloads a glb file, something I wasn’t familiar with.
sentences.zh: 缺点是这会下载一个 glb 文件，这是我不熟悉的。

sentences.en: Fusion allows us to easily import obj files, so we need to convert it to that.
sentences.zh: Fusion 允许我们轻松导入 obj 文件，因此我们需要将其转换为 obj 文件。

sentences.en: After trying a bunch of scripts and websites, I honestly found this website to be the best.
sentences.zh: 在尝试了一堆脚本和网站之后，老实说，我发现这个网站是最好的。

sentences.en: Little janky, but it works.
sentences.zh: 虽然有点笨拙，但确实有效。

blocks.html_en: Also note that the resulting obj file (and the folder it’s contained in) often won’t render textures inside Fusion 360, but when you export them from Fusion they show up as expected.

sentences.en: Also note that the resulting obj file (and the folder it’s contained in) often won’t render textures inside Fusion 360, but when you export them from Fusion they show up as expected.
sentences.zh: 另请注意，生成的 obj 文件（及其包含的文件夹）通常不会在 Fusion 360 内渲染纹理，但当您从 Fusion 导出它们时，它们会按预期显示。

blocks.html_en: 3D Warehouse

sentences.en: 3D Warehouse
sentences.zh: 3D 仓库

blocks.html_en: That covers a lot of furniture, but not everything. Maybe you want to see how a stand mixer looks on the counter or if you can fit a rice cooker comfortably. Heck, you can find your car and put it in the garage for reference.

sentences.en: That covers a lot of furniture, but not everything.
sentences.zh: 这涵盖了很多家具，但不是所有家具。

sentences.en: Maybe you want to see how a stand mixer looks on the counter or if you can fit a rice cooker comfortably.
sentences.zh: 也许您想看看立式搅拌机在柜台上的样子，或者您是否可以舒适地放置电饭锅。

sentences.en: Heck, you can find your car and put it in the garage for reference.
sentences.zh: 哎呀，你可以找到你的车并将其放入车库以供参考。

blocks.html_en: This is where 3D Warehouse comes in, it’s a community-driven website where people can upload free 3D models they create and easily import them into Sketchup, another popular piece of 3D modeling software (that might even work better than Fusion for house design, I dunno, haven’t used it much).

sentences.en: This is where 3D Warehouse comes in, it’s a community-driven website where people can upload free 3D models they create and easily import them into Sketchup, another popular piece of 3D modeling software (that might even work better than Fusion for house design, I dunno, haven’t used it much).
sentences.zh: 这就是 3D Warehouse 的用武之地，它是一个社区驱动的网站，人们可以上传他们创建的免费 3D 模型，并轻松地将它们导入到 Sketchup，这是另一个流行的 3D 建模软件（在房屋设计方面，它甚至可能比 Fusion 更好，我不知道，我没用过它太多）。

blocks.html_en: Problem is, the files aren’t easily usable in Fusion, but I found a nice workaround.

sentences.en: Problem is, the files aren’t easily usable in Fusion, but I found a nice workaround.
sentences.zh: 问题是，这些文件在 Fusion 中不容易使用，但我找到了一个很好的解决方法。

blocks.html_en: If you open the URL on your iOS device instead, it gives you the option to view it in 3D inside your current environment. Within that view, if you tap the share button you get access to the actual USDZ file that powers this experience, at which point you can just AirDrop it to your Mac. Nice!

sentences.en: If you open the URL on your iOS device instead, it gives you the option to view it in 3D inside your current environment.
sentences.zh: 如果您在 iOS 设备上打开该 URL，您可以选择在当前环境中以 3D 方式查看它。

sentences.en: Within that view, if you tap the share button you get access to the actual USDZ file that powers this experience, at which point you can just AirDrop it to your Mac.
sentences.zh: 在该视图中，如果您点击共享按钮，您就可以访问为这种体验提供支持的实际 USDZ 文件，此时您可以将其通过 AirDrop 发送到您的 Mac。

sentences.en: Nice!
sentences.zh: 好的！

blocks.html_en: From there, even though we love a USDZ file, Fusion seemingly doesn’t for importing objects, so back to that previous website to convert to OBJ. From there it’s as simple as bringing it into Fusion and placing it.

sentences.en: From there, even though we love a USDZ file, Fusion seemingly doesn’t for importing objects, so back to that previous website to convert to OBJ.
sentences.zh: 从那里开始，尽管我们喜欢 USDZ 文件，但 Fusion 似乎不适合导入对象，因此回到之前的网站将其转换为 OBJ。

sentences.en: From there it’s as simple as bringing it into Fusion and placing it.
sentences.zh: 从那里开始，就像将其带入 Fusion 并放置一样简单。

blocks.html_en: <figcaption>Look, a stand mixer and a sink!</figcaption>

sentences.en: Look, a stand mixer and a sink!
sentences.zh: 看，立式搅拌机和水槽！

blocks.html_en: This website is seriously awesome, there’s a model for just about anything you’d put in your house.

sentences.en: This website is seriously awesome, there’s a model for just about anything you’d put in your house.
sentences.zh: 这个网站非常棒，几乎所有你放在家里的东西都有一个模型。

blocks.html_en: Programming!

sentences.en: Programming!
sentences.zh: 编程！

blocks.html_en: Now that I have something I’m happy with, I remembered Apple platforms love the USDZ file format for 3D models, and sure enough Fusion had a USDZ export option. Nice!

sentences.en: Now that I have something I’m happy with, I remembered Apple platforms love the USDZ file format for 3D models, and sure enough Fusion had a USDZ export option.
sentences.zh: 现在我有了一些令我满意的东西，我记得 Apple 平台喜欢 3D 模型的 USDZ 文件格式，而且 Fusion 果然有 USDZ 导出选项。

sentences.en: Nice!
sentences.zh: 好的！

blocks.html_en: With a file in hand, we’re getting somewhere, so I AirDropped to it to my Vision Pro and opened it. This worked pretty okay for viewing it, and you could even walk around a little bit, but unless you live in a warehouse walking the full length of a virtual house without bumping into something and ending up in those VR fail compilations is pretty tricky. I want something better.

sentences.en: With a file in hand, we’re getting somewhere, so I AirDropped to it to my Vision Pro and opened it.
sentences.zh: 有了文件在手，我们已经取得了进展，所以我将其通过 AirDropped 发送到我的 Vision Pro 并打开它。

sentences.en: This worked pretty okay for viewing it, and you could even walk around a little bit, but unless you live in a warehouse walking the full length of a virtual house without bumping into something and ending up in those VR fail compilations is pretty tricky.
sentences.zh: 这对于观看它来说效果很好，你甚至可以四处走动，但除非你住在仓库里，否则在虚拟房子的整个长度上行走而不撞到任何东西并最终陷入那些 VR 失败编译中是相当棘手的。

sentences.en: I want something better.
sentences.zh: 我想要更好的东西。

blocks.html_en: This is where vibe coding is perfect: putting something technically impressive together when you would have never bothered to take weeks to put it together traditionally. Is the code perfect? Nah, but the alternative is it never existing, and it’s just “for fun” anyway.

sentences.en: This is where vibe coding is perfect: putting something technically impressive together when you would have never bothered to take weeks to put it together traditionally.
sentences.zh: 这就是氛围编码的完美之处：将技术上令人印象深刻的东西组合在一起，而传统上你从来不需要花几周的时间来组合它们。

sentences.en: Is the code perfect?
sentences.zh: 代码完美吗？

sentences.en: Nah, but the alternative is it never existing, and it’s just “for fun” anyway.
sentences.zh: 不，但另一种选择是它永远不存在，而且它只是“为了好玩”。

blocks.html_en: After some intense typing with a combination of Claude and Codex over the course of a morning I had something I was pretty happy with. I named it Prospector (can’t remember why) and I’ve been really happy with it.

sentences.en: After some intense typing with a combination of Claude and Codex over the course of a morning I had something I was pretty happy with.
sentences.zh: 经过一个早上的结合 Claude 和 Codex 的大量打字后，我得到了一些我非常满意的东西。

sentences.en: I named it Prospector (can’t remember why) and I’ve been really happy with it.
sentences.zh: 我把它命名为 Prospector（不记得为什么了），我对它非常满意。

blocks.html_en: <figcaption>It looks jittery as all VR videos do, but it's super smooth in real life</figcaption>

sentences.en: It looks jittery as all VR videos do, but it's super smooth in real life
sentences.zh: 它看起来像所有 VR 视频一样紧张，但在现实生活中却超级流畅

blocks.html_en: Here are a bunch of the features that level it up beyond just viewing a USDZ file in the Files app:

sentences.en: Here are a bunch of the features that level it up beyond just viewing a USDZ file in the Files app:
sentences.zh: 除了在“文件”应用程序中查看 USDZ 文件之外，还有一系列功能可以将其升级：

blocks.html_en: • Controller support! Walk around like you’re in a 3D video game, with motion controls as well as the ability to rotate the camera (you can still walk and look around normally of course, this just augments that).

sentences.en: Controller support!
sentences.zh: 控制器支持！

sentences.en: Walk around like you’re in a 3D video game, with motion controls as well as the ability to rotate the camera (you can still walk and look around normally of course, this just augments that).
sentences.zh: 像在 3D 视频游戏中一样四处走动，具有运动控制以及旋转摄像头的功能（当然，您仍然可以正常行走和环顾四周，这只是增强了这一点）。

blocks.html_en: • Skybox! Pretty rudimentary, but added a forest style skybox as the exterior of the world so if you look out a window you don’t just see your current environment

sentences.en: Skybox!
sentences.zh: 天空盒！

sentences.en: Pretty rudimentary, but added a forest style skybox as the exterior of the world so if you look out a window you don’t just see your current environment
sentences.zh: 相当简陋，但添加了一个森林风格的天空盒作为世界的外部，所以如果你向窗外看，你不仅仅看到当前的环境

blocks.html_en: • Terrain following! If you tap the right D-pad button the controller will map you to the terrain, so you’ll go up and down with any undulations in the terrain. This is really handy if you have a survey of your property done so can effectively have a full view of your property’s terrain and “walk” through it

sentences.en: Terrain following!
sentences.zh: 地形跟随！

sentences.en: If you tap the right D-pad button the controller will map you to the terrain, so you’ll go up and down with any undulations in the terrain.
sentences.zh: 如果您点击右方向键按钮，控制器会将您映射到地形，这样您就可以随着地形的任何起伏而上下移动。

sentences.en: This is really handy if you have a survey of your property done so can effectively have a full view of your property’s terrain and “walk” through it
sentences.zh: 如果您对您的财产进行了调查，这真的很方便，这样可以有效地全面了解您的财产的地形并“步行”穿过它

blocks.html_en: • Toggle real life! If you hold your thumb and middle finger together for a moment it will toggle the virtual world on and off, this makes it feel safer if you want to take a step forward in virtual reality but are unsure if you’re going to bump into a table in real life.

sentences.en: Toggle real life!
sentences.zh: 切换现实生活！

sentences.en: If you hold your thumb and middle finger together for a moment it will toggle the virtual world on and off, this makes it feel safer if you want to take a step forward in virtual reality but are unsure if you’re going to bump into a table in real life.
sentences.zh: 如果你将拇指和中指放在一起一会儿，它就会打开和关闭虚拟世界，如果你想在虚拟现实中向前迈出一步，但不确定是否会在现实生活中撞到桌子，这会让你感觉更安全。

blocks.html_en: • Take flight! With the triggers you can fly up or down, great for going between floors for instance, and then if you press up on the D-pad it’ll reset you to the ground level.

sentences.en: Take flight!
sentences.zh: 起飞！

sentences.en: With the triggers you can fly up or down, great for going between floors for instance, and then if you press up on the D-pad it’ll reset you to the ground level.
sentences.zh: 通过触发器，你可以向上或向下飞行，非常适合在楼层之间移动，然后如果你按下方向键，它会将你重置到地面。

blocks.html_en: • Speed mode! Pressing left on the D-pad makes you move 6× faster, which is really, well, fast when you’re crossing a big property rather than poking around a single room.

sentences.en: Speed mode!
sentences.zh: 极速模式！

sentences.en: Pressing left on the D-pad makes you move 6× faster, which is really, well, fast when you’re crossing a big property rather than poking around a single room.
sentences.zh: 按方向键左键可以让你的移动速度加快 6 倍，当你穿过一个大地产而不是在一个房间里闲逛时，这确实非常快。

blocks.html_en: With all those together, this is a really helpful way to view USDZ files on the Vision Pro. You can really easily explore a space and position yourself in new areas to look around, and even take off the headset to show a spouse or friend so you can gather their input on any changes. Then making a change is as simple as tweaking the file in Fusion, re-exporting, then re-running.

sentences.en: With all those together, this is a really helpful way to view USDZ files on the Vision Pro.
sentences.zh: 综上所述，这是在 Vision Pro 上查看 USDZ 文件的一种非常有用的方法。

sentences.en: You can really easily explore a space and position yourself in new areas to look around, and even take off the headset to show a spouse or friend so you can gather their input on any changes.
sentences.zh: 您可以真正轻松地探索一个空间并将自己置于新的区域中环顾四周，甚至摘下耳机向配偶或朋友展示，以便您可以收集他们对任何变化的意见。

sentences.en: Then making a change is as simple as tweaking the file in Fusion, re-exporting, then re-running.
sentences.zh: 然后进行更改就像在 Fusion 中调整文件、重新导出然后重新运行一样简单。

blocks.html_en: If you want to play around with Prospector, my super janky, vibe coded USDZ viewer, I put the contents up on GitHub (it would take a fair bit more work to polish this up into something I’d be comfortable submitting to the App Store).

blocks.html_en: No seriously, this feels so powerful. When we finally decided on a plan, through the fancy Revit software our architect uses he was able to bring us on a 3D walkthrough of our future house. It was cool, kinda like a Google Streetview-esque experience where you could click to teleport around the house and drag to look around.

blocks.html_en: But honestly, after already seeing it in full, immersive 3D where you can look around and feel like you’re there, we already felt like we knew the place. content_html_zh:
July 29, 2026

在过去的一年里，我承认我并没有经常使用 Vision Pro，但最近我发现了一种超级方便的用途，只要你有合适的工具，它的使用绝对令人难以置信。

经过多年的公寓生活，我和我的女朋友最近开始建造我们的（第一个！ 令人兴奋！） 家，这绝对是一场选择和决定的旋风。 也许这就是我们都是程序员的地方，但特别是对我来说，我以软件为导向的大脑感觉与这个设计住宅的世界几乎不相容（她是推动这个项目前进的主要人）。

在软件中，如果你在使用一段时间后不喜欢某个功能，你可以调整它或完全删除它（尝试用放置不当的墙来做到这一点）。 在这里，做出的决定感觉是重大且难以承诺的。

最重要的是，目前世界上许多地方的房地产市场都非常昂贵（当然包括我们的），因此充分利用每一平方英尺感觉至关重要。

（别担心，我们有一位出色的架构师，他会熟练地指导我们，但最终一切都由我们来签署！）

进入 Vision Pro

看着潜在平面图的 PDF，你不会（或者至少我不会）形成太多的规模感或与一堆黑色矩形的联系。 这个房间说是 13 英尺 x 15 英尺，我想我可以拿出卷尺，但这感觉怎么样？ 这个走廊会不会很拥挤？ 当你第一次走进房子时，你能看到什么？

然后我突然想到：虚拟现实！ 还有其他 VR 设备具有更好的游戏能力，但我不确定是否有一款消费设备在用高分辨率屏幕渲染虚拟世界，然后用大量传感器将你置身其中时，比纸面上的 Vision Pro 更好。

问题是，如何从平面图转向虚拟现实？

让我们开始创造吧

我有一些使用 Fusion 360（面向爱好者的免费 3D 建模软件）的经验，因此我产生了尝试快速构建 3D 平面图的想法。 没什么特别的，只有地板、天花板和墙壁，还有门上的洞。

如果您不熟悉 3D 设计工具，这是一个很棒的第一个项目，您基本上只是以 2D 形式绘制平面图，然后挤出墙壁。 YouTube 和提出人工智能问题是 2026 年学习这项方便技能的绝佳资源。 Fiverr 等网站也是一个很好的资源，我相信那里有很多人可以以合理的价格获取您感兴趣的平面图并将其转换为 3D 文件。

升级它

一堆墙壁、天花板和墙上的洞非常强大，但空间中没有实际的物体或纹理，当你“四处走动”时，仍然有点难以获得比例。

你知道当你第一次走进一间空荡荡的公寓时，你会想“天哪，这里有这么多空间”，然后你添加了你的物品，但突然就没有了？ 有点像这样，我们需要在空间中添加一些模型和材料，以实际地扎根我们的视角并赋予事物规模，否则感觉就像在仓库里走来走去。

添加纹理

快速简单的一个。 在 Fusion 中，点击“A”键打开“外观”面板，您可以将一堆常见纹理（例如木材、石头或油漆）拖放到对象上。 这确实有助于打破所有事物都具有相同的沉闷纹理的单调性，并且实际上赋予了地方深度。

窗户甚至还有玻璃纹理，非常方便。

IKEA

我可以模拟一个柜台或一个厨房岛（只是一堆矩形），但除此之外的任何东西我都会敲出。 值得庆幸的是，宜家拥有大量带有相应 3D 模型的家具，即使您不是宜家的大佬（哇，您不喜欢吗），拥有您所在位置的最终家具的近似值确实可以帮助您了解事物如何组合在一起并如何定位。

问题是，据我所知，没有简单的方法可以访问这些 3D 模型。 值得庆幸的是，通过 Tampermonkey 浏览器扩展程序的脚本，您可以轻松下载它们。 遗憾的是，并非宜家的每件商品都有 3D 模型，但似乎大多数商品都有。

这对于在空间中添加沙发、床、桌子、地毯等非常方便，因此当您走进卧室时，您的眼睛会看到床和桌子，并对房间的规模有一个很好的了解，这可以让您了解房间的大小是否合适或尺寸是否合适，并且您可以想象存在于该空间中会是什么样子。

缺点是这会下载一个 glb 文件，这是我不熟悉的。 Fusion 允许我们轻松导入 obj 文件，因此我们需要将其转换为 obj 文件。 在尝试了一堆脚本和网站之后，老实说，我发现这个网站是最好的。 虽然有点笨拙，但确实有效。

另请注意，生成的 obj 文件（及其包含的文件夹）通常不会在 Fusion 360 内渲染纹理，但当您从 Fusion 导出它们时，它们会按预期显示。

3D 仓库

这涵盖了很多家具，但不是所有家具。 也许您想看看立式搅拌机在柜台上的样子，或者您是否可以舒适地放置电饭锅。 哎呀，你可以找到你的车并将其放入车库以供参考。

这就是 3D Warehouse 的用武之地，它是一个社区驱动的网站，人们可以上传他们创建的免费 3D 模型，并轻松地将它们导入到 Sketchup，这是另一个流行的 3D 建模软件（在房屋设计方面，它甚至可能比 Fusion 更好，我不知道，我没用过它太多）。

问题是，这些文件在 Fusion 中不容易使用，但我找到了一个很好的解决方法。

如果您在 iOS 设备上打开该 URL，您可以选择在当前环境中以 3D 方式查看它。 在该视图中，如果您点击共享按钮，您就可以访问为这种体验提供支持的实际 USDZ 文件，此时您可以将其通过 AirDrop 发送到您的 Mac。 好的！

从那里开始，尽管我们喜欢 USDZ 文件，但 Fusion 似乎不适合导入对象，因此回到之前的网站将其转换为 OBJ。 从那里开始，就像将其带入 Fusion 并放置一样简单。

这个网站非常棒，几乎所有你放在家里的东西都有一个模型。

编程！

现在我有了一些令我满意的东西，我记得 Apple 平台喜欢 3D 模型的 USDZ 文件格式，而且 Fusion 果然有 USDZ 导出选项。 好的！

有了文件在手，我们已经取得了进展，所以我将其通过 AirDropped 发送到我的 Vision Pro 并打开它。 这对于观看它来说效果很好，你甚至可以四处走动，但除非你住在仓库里，否则在虚拟房子的整个长度上行走而不撞到任何东西并最终陷入那些 VR 失败编译中是相当棘手的。 我想要更好的东西。

这就是氛围编码的完美之处：将技术上令人印象深刻的东西组合在一起，而传统上你从来不需要花几周的时间来组合它们。 代码完美吗？ 不，但另一种选择是它永远不存在，而且它只是“为了好玩”。

经过一个早上的结合 Claude 和 Codex 的大量打字后，我得到了一些我非常满意的东西。 我把它命名为 Prospector（不记得为什么了），我对它非常满意。

除了在“文件”应用程序中查看 USDZ 文件之外，还有一系列功能可以将其升级：

  • 控制器支持！ 像在 3D 视频游戏中一样四处走动，具有运动控制以及旋转摄像头的功能（当然，您仍然可以正常行走和环顾四周，这只是增强了这一点）。
  • 天空盒！ 相当简陋，但添加了一个森林风格的天空盒作为世界的外部，所以如果你向窗外看，你不仅仅看到当前的环境
  • 地形跟随！ 如果您点击右方向键按钮，控制器会将您映射到地形，这样您就可以随着地形的任何起伏而上下移动。 如果您对您的财产进行了调查，这真的很方便，这样可以有效地全面了解您的财产的地形并“步行”穿过它
  • 切换现实生活！ 如果你将拇指和中指放在一起一会儿，它就会打开和关闭虚拟世界，如果你想在虚拟现实中向前迈出一步，但不确定是否会在现实生活中撞到桌子，这会让你感觉更安全。
  • 起飞！ 通过触发器，你可以向上或向下飞行，非常适合在楼层之间移动，然后如果你按下方向键，它会将你重置到地面。
  • 极速模式！ 按方向键左键可以让你的移动速度加快 6 倍，当你穿过一个大地产而不是在一个房间里闲逛时，这确实非常快。

综上所述，这是在 Vision Pro 上查看 USDZ 文件的一种非常有用的方法。 您可以真正轻松地探索一个空间并将自己置于新的区域中环顾四周，甚至摘下耳机向配偶或朋友展示，以便您可以收集他们对任何变化的意见。 然后进行更改就像在 Fusion 中调整文件、重新导出然后重新运行一样简单。

下载链接

如果你想使用 Prospector，我的超级简陋、vibe 编码的 USDZ 查看器，我将内容放在 GitHub 上（需要做更多的工作才能将其完善为我愿意提交到 App Store 的内容）。

使用它就像宣传的那样：janky。 获取您的 USDZ 文件，将其导入 Xcode，然后在 ImmersiveView.swift 中将 USDZ 文件名更改为您的文件名。 您还可以调整天空盒（Poly Haven 有很多很棒的选项）。 然后，只需将控制器与 Vision Pro 配对并在您的设备上运行该项目即可。

只要知道我的代码是 0%，所以如果它很糟糕，你就不能评判我。 你不敢。 我很敏感。 判断人工智能。

这太棒了

不认真，这感觉太强大了。 当我们最终决定一个计划时，通过我们的建筑师使用的精美 Revit 软件，他能够为我们带来未来房屋的 3D 演练。 这很酷，有点像谷歌街景式的体验，你可以点击在房子周围传送并拖动来环顾四周。

但老实说，在看到完整的、身临其境的 3D 体验后，您可以环顾四周，感觉身临其境，我们已经感觉我们熟悉这个地方了。 感觉就像在未来的某一天，访问 3D 中的潜在设计将成为该过程的核心部分，如果您拥有硬件，那么未来今天就成为可能。
